meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Vercel CLI 安装进 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据,之后 agent 能部署网页应用到 Vercel、列出部署记录。过程中需要你提供一个 Vercel 令牌。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时。前提是 OneCLI 已可用;若检测不到,会提示你先运行 /init-onecli,再重试该技能。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds the Vercel CLI to NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials for api.vercel.com. Agents can then deploy web apps to Vercel and list deployments; you must supply a Vercel token.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw agents to deploy web apps to Vercel. OneCLI must be working; if it is missing, the skill tells you to run /init-onecli first, then retry.

say_en.note: Installs the CLI, then asks for your Vercel token
Stored in OneCLI and assigned to all agents

say_en.text: Deploy this app to Vercel production
